title: SSP-0.3 — Projects Subject Foundation Closeout Evidence
summary: verify and transfer the exact read-only Projects subject projection and capability-gated None or Folder assignment foundation
content_html:
SSP-0.3 — Projects Subject Foundation Closeout Evidence

Outcome

SSP-0 is complete. The local Manage Projects detail uses the exact active {scope, sub_scope, doc_id} for passive Subject information and capability-gated Assign subject. The focused modal supports None and Folder, loads the current source revision, submits one confirmed authoring_subject mutation, contains status, refreshes the same detail after success, and leaves source unchanged on cancellation. User hands-on acceptance confirmed the delivered interaction.

Projects folder_path now has one focused authoring owner. Relative paths, absolute POSIX paths, and local file: URLs resolve to a portable path beneath DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR; the base itself is the confinement boundary and projects/ is the current working convention. Edit metadata retains universal fields and other explicitly configured owners.

Evidence

  • The focused Python set passes 86 tests across metadata, routes, mutation planning and execution, customisation, public runtime boundaries, and exact managed-document targets.
  • Browser module smokes pass for exact Projects detail and Info projection, rendered and source contexts, Folder and None states, capability absence, cancellation, clear/success refresh, contained errors, modal lifecycle, and public router isolation.
  • The localhost management-service smoke passes the configured route and client contract, including read-only behavior when management capability is unavailable.
  • Explicit JavaScript and Python lint, Python compilation, the seven-boundary source-lint profile (var/admin/test-runs/ssp-0-closeout/summary.md), the 241-document Projects dry-build drift check, generated Studio document/search projections, JSON validation, and git diff --check pass.

Independent Review And Transfer

The final diff keeps subject availability with the exact registered DocsSubScopeAssignableFieldGroup, server field authority with the resolved customisation, value normalization with the Projects adapter and shared local-target resolver, and atomic mutation with the management service. The Projects browser contribution owns subject meaning, modal response validation, detail refresh, and Finder action. Shared Info renders supplied passive fields, and public routes retain their public-safe projection.

Info Panel, Management Operations, and Sub-Scope Customisation Architecture now own the shipped contracts. SSP-1 consumes the accepted group, route, modal, Info, and exact-target seams for Work/Series. SSP-4 retains creation and acceptance of analysis/works; the independent Tag delivery retains Tag field authoring.
